ValidationRule.description: The contact and account must be related in order to save a case. (Does not apply to NCSP).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
(($RecordType.Name == 'Task Request' || $RecordType.Name == 'CAC - DP Closure' || $RecordType.Name == 'CAC - SKP RM' || $RecordType.Name == 'CAC - SKP Shred' || $RecordType.Name == 'Retention') && Not(isblank( Contact.Id)) && Not(isblank( AccountId))) &&
((NOT(ISBLANK(Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK( Contact.Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c)) && Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c <> Contact.Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c) ||
(ISBLANK(Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c) && ISBLANK( Contact.Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c) && Contact.Account.Id <> AccountId) ||
(NOT(ISBLANK(Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c)) && ISBLANK( Contact.Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c) && Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c <> Contact.Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c) ||
(ISBLANK(Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c) && NOT(ISBLANK( Contact.Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c)) && Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c <> Contact.Account.IM_IMGA_Indexed__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contact must be related to the Account selected or within its IMGA's hierarchy.
